title: Grade 3 Science: Singapore MOE Inquiry
description: Diversity of living/non-living things, plant/animal life cycles, materials & magnetic forces.

items.prompt: Which of the following groups contains ONLY non-flowering plants that reproduce by spores?
items.explanation: Ferns and mosses are non-flowering plants that reproduce using spores rather than seeds.

items.prompt: Which material is flexible, waterproof, and ideal for making swimming caps?
items.explanation: Rubber is flexible, elastic, and completely waterproof, making it ideal for swimming gear.

items.prompt: Which animal life cycle has 4 distinct stages: egg, larva, pupa, and adult?
items.explanation: Butterflies undergo complete metamorphosis with 4 stages: egg, caterpillar (larva), chrysalis (pupa), adult.

items.prompt: Milo brings the South pole of a magnet close to the North pole of another magnet. What will happen?
items.explanation: Opposite magnetic poles (North and South) attract each other.

items.prompt: Which of the following objects can be attracted by a magnet?
items.explanation: Steel is a magnetic material containing iron that is attracted by magnets.

items.prompt: What is the main function of the roots of a plant?

options.text: To absorb water and minerals and anchor the plant in the soil
To catch sunlight for making food

items.explanation: Roots anchor the plant firmly and absorb essential water and nutrients from the soil.

items.prompt: Why are mushrooms and toadstools classified as Fungi rather than Plants?

options.text: They cannot make their own food through photosynthesis

items.explanation: Fungi lack chlorophyll and absorb nutrients from decaying organic matter instead of photosynthesizing.

items.prompt: Which physical property explains why cooking pots are made of metal while handles are made of plastic?
items.explanation: Metal conducts heat well to cook food, while plastic is a poor conductor of heat to protect hands from burns.

items.prompt: How do mammals differ from all other animal groups (birds, reptiles, fish, insects)?

options.text: They have hair/fur and produce milk for their young
They can fly in the sky

items.explanation: Mammals have hair/fur, give live birth, and nurse their young with milk.

items.prompt: A seed needs three essential conditions to germinate. What are they?
items.explanation: Seeds require Water, Oxygen, and appropriate Warmth (WOW) to germinate before needing sunlight for photosynthesis.
